lines.text: Woah there! Take a breath, kid. You look like you've seen a ghost.

choices.text: Where am I? How did I get here?
I need to get out of here.

lines.text: You're deep inside the dungeon. Most folks who wake up here have no clue how they arrived either.
Keep your guard up. Slimes and worse monsters are crawling through these corridors, and they don't like visitors.
Is there anything else you need before you step into the dark?

choices.text: How do I survive down here?
I'll figure it out on my own.

lines.text: Name's Wilky. Just another traveller trying to keep my head on straight down here.
Stand your ground and don't let fear freeze you up. If a fight starts, use whatever you can find to defend yourself.
Good luck out there. Keep your sword handy and watch out for the slimes!
